name: Dropdown
purpose: Menu button: a button that reveals a list of actions (Edit, Duplicate, Delete). Implements the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern on web and an action sheet on native. Not a form control — for picking a value use Select.

props.name: label
props.description: Trigger text, or the aria-label when triggerIcon is set.

props.name: items
props.type: Array<{ id: string; label: string; icon?: IconName; onSelect?: () => void; disabled?: boolean; tone?: 'default' | 'danger' }>

props.name: align
props.description: Align the menu to the trigger's start or end edge.

states.name: open
states.description: Menu visible, focus on an item, aria-expanded=true.

states.name: item focus/hover
states.description: Item highlighted with hover background and focus ring.

states.name: item disabled
states.description: Item announced as unavailable; skipped by arrow keys.

keyboard.action: Open and focus the first item.
Open and focus the last item.
Jump to the next item starting with that letter.
Close and return focus to the trigger.

screenReader: Trigger announced as '<label>, menu button, collapsed/expanded'.
Items announced as '<label>, menu item, n of m'.
accessibility.focus: Focus moves into the menu on open and back to the trigger on close.

variants.name: overflow
variants.useWhen: Row actions in tables and cards.

do: Use for 3+ secondary actions that don't fit inline.
Put destructive actions last with tone 'danger'.
dont: Don't use for selecting form values — use Select.
Don't hide the primary action of a page in a menu.

related.name: Button
related.reason: Primary actions should be visible buttons.

example.web:
<Dropdown
  label="Match actions"
  triggerIcon="more-horizontal"
  triggerVariant="tertiary"
  align="end"
  items={[
    { id: 'edit', label: 'Edit score', icon: 'edit', onSelect: edit },
    { id: 'reschedule', label: 'Reschedule', icon: 'calendar', onSelect: reschedule },
    { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete match', icon: 'trash', tone: 'danger', onSelect: confirmDelete },
  ]}
/>
